lead_html:
PUMP_PORTS_REDRAW_SIZED_FOR_FAT_PIPES — owner 2026-10-23: "We should unfortunately regen the pumps and such to have connectors that match the more modern pipe and hose sizes. looks a bit silly."

Each pump's four side ports were shrunk in place (deterministic edit, same pixels): flange 0.29–0.31 → 0.205 cell, neck 0.21–0.23 → 0.15 cell (pipe 0.136, hose 0.18, hose coupling ≈0.22). Flange faces stay on the footprint edge; hose joint gates green. Your kept art is replaced; the previous picture is the REVERT column.

⚠ The reference pictures are OFFLINE composites, not game captures. The art-eval pipeline HELD these (machine template needs an in-game assembled capture; no game this session) — live look owed. Note the hose under-coupler drawn beneath a connected port (collar 0.3125, pipe 0.219 cell, C# constants) is now wider than the slim neck; filed separately.

Modern pump untouched here (the Modern redraw helper owns it).
